completed_tasks.name: Implement PageIndex schema and clinical reasoning tree generation
completed_tasks.notes: Decided against auto-generating trees from existing data sources: SFT medical dialogue data is Simplified Chinese TCM diagnosis Q&A (wrong language, wrong domain), and service_items payment_rules are generic coverage boilerplate with no clinical steps. Instead hand-wrote 4 more high-quality Traditional Chinese PageIndex trees (electrowave facelift, HA filler, fractional laser, HIFU lifting) alongside the existing 2 (laser resurfacing, botox), covering different anesthesia/downtime profiles as a quality baseline for TASK-004's LLM prompt. All 6 verified clean of price leakage and Simplified Chinese. Also found and fixed page_index_fts, which was still on unicode61 tokenizer from before the TASK-001 trigram migration — new trees were completely unsearchable until fixed; now all three FTS5 tables (drugs_fts, service_items_fts, page_index_fts) consistently use trigram.
